newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters urges restored business confidence.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters urges restored business confidence.

text.p: Treasurer Winston Peters said on Thursday if businesses looked forward not back they would see reasons to be more positive.
"A look forward would, I suggest, justify a more positive view of the business environment," Peters said in a lunchtime speech to the Marlborough Chamber of Commerce.
He said recent declines in business confidence had lowered Treasury's growth outlook which in turn had a significant impact on the tax take.
"Confidence has not slipped anything like the extent it did in the recession of the early 1990s," Peters said.
He said growth had bottomed out above two percent.
"But the fall is a worry ... particularly because this slip in confidence seems too much like driving by the rear-view mirror."
